articles.purpose: Use this chapter to prepare and check the theft protection and automatic locking workflow on this firmware.
prerequisites: Keep a working screen lock and fallback credential.
steps: Review Theft Detection Lock and Offline Device Lock separately. No switches were changed during inspection.
Read the setup prompts: the page describes locking after suspected theft and after going offline.
Review Remote Lock and Find & erase your device as separate recovery routes. Device identifier on lock screen concerns IMEI visibility.
After a protection lock, use the normal unlock method. Do not simulate theft by running with or dropping the phone.
